project_type: React SPA with localStorage persistence - nursing ops platform
test_framework: No test framework configured - verification via build only
verification_instructions: Run npm run build from the project root and confirm zero errors. Optionally run npm run lint for static analysis.
environment_constraints: No backend - all data stored in localStorage. No test framework. Verification is limited to successful Vite build.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing module patterns: page in src/pages/, components in src/components/<module>/, seed data in src/data/, storage helpers in src/lib/storage.js, state in src/context/AppContext.jsx, route in src/App.jsx, nav item in src/components/layout/Sidebar.jsx
key_patterns: Tabbed page layout (see DocumentManagement.jsx), purple gradient sidebar with lucide-react icons, useAppContext() hook for global state, getData/setData wrappers in storage.js, seeded data with deterministic pseudo-random generator, write-through to localStorage via useCallback update functions in AppProvider
directory_structure: src/pages/ - page-level components; src/components/<module>/ - sub-components per module; src/data/ - seed data generators; src/lib/ - utility functions (storage.js); src/context/ - global state (AppContext.jsx); src/components/layout/ - Layout.jsx + Sidebar.jsx
